sections.theory:
19.4.1 Ozonolysis of Alkenes

Ozone reacts vigorously with alkenes to form an unstable intermediate compound called ozonide. The ozonide is reduced directly to aldehydes and ketones by zinc and water, to produce aldehyde and/or ketones. The reaction is called ozonolysis. Symmetrical alkene produces single product while asymmetric alkene yield a mixture of aldehydes/ketones (Section 16.5.7.7). For example, ozonolysis of symmetric but-2-ene (both cis and trans) gives only acetaldehyde, while asymmetric 2-methylbut-2-ene yields a mixture of acetaldehyde and acetone.

19.4.2 Hydration of Alkynes

Alkynes undergo acid-catalyzed addition of water across the triple bond in the presence of mercuric sulphate and sulfuric acid as a catalyst to produce carbonyl compounds. Acetaldehyde is produced in case of acetylene, while ketones are produced from higher alkynes (Section 16.7.8.4).

19.4.3 Oxidation of Alcohols

Oxidation of a primary alcohol with strong oxidizing agents like, acidified chromate (CrO₄²⁻), dichromate (Cr₂O₇²⁻) or permanganate (MnO₄⁻) solution leads to the formation of a carboxylic acid as final product, through aldehydes intermediate. However, good yield of aldehydes can be obtained using oxidizing agents such as pyridinium chlorochromate (PCC), a complex of chromium trioxide with pyridine and HCl, without over (excessive) oxidation (Section 18.1.7.5).

Secondary alcohols are oxidized to ketones by the same reagents that oxidize primary alcohols.

19.4.4 Friedel-Crafts Acylation of Aromatics

Benzene reacts with acid halides (or anhydrides) in the presence of a Lewis acid catalyst to give aromatic ketones. For example, benzene react with acetyl chloride in the presence of aluminum chloride catalyst to form acetophenone (Section 16.8.5.2.6).

اوزون له الکینونو سره په زوره تعامل کوي او یو بې ثباته منځنی مرکب جوړوي چې اوزونایډ بلل کېږي. اوزونایډ د جستو او اوبو په واسطه مستقیم الدیهایډونو او کیټونونو ته ارجاع کېږي. دې تعامل ته اوزونولایسس وايي. متناظر الکین یو محصول او نامتناظر الکین د الدیهایډونو/کیټونونو ګډوله ورکوي (برخه 16.5.7.7). د بېلګې په توګه د متناظر بیوټ-2-ین (cis او trans دواړه) اوزونولایسس یوازې اسیټالدیهاید ورکوي، خو نامتناظر 2-میتایل بیوټ-2-ین د اسیټالدیهاید او اسیتون ګډوله ورکوي.

19.4.2 د الکاینونو هایدرېشن

الکاینونه د کتلست په توګه د مرکیوریک سلفېټ او سلفوریک اسید په شتون کې پر درې ګوني تړون د اوبو اسیدي کتلستي اضافه کوي او کاربونیل مرکبات جوړوي. د اسیتیلین په حالت کې اسیټالدیهاید جوړېږي، خو له لوړو الکاینونو کیټونونه جوړېږي (برخه 16.7.8.4).

19.4.3 د الکولونو اکسیډېشن

د قوي اکسیډایز کوونکو عاملونو لکه اسیدي کرومېټ (CrO₄²⁻)، ډای کرومېټ (Cr₂O₇²⁻) یا پرمنګنېټ (MnO₄⁻) محلول په واسطه د لومړني الکول اکسیډېشن د الدیهاید منځني له لارې د وروستي محصول په توګه کاربوکسیلیک اسید ورکوي. خو د پیریډینیم کلوروکرومېټ (PCC)، چې له پیریډین او HCl سره د کرومیم ټرای اکساید کمپلېکس دی، په څېر اکسیډایز کوونکو عاملونو سره له ډېر اکسیډېشن پرته د الدیهایډونو ښه حاصل ترلاسه کېدای شي (برخه 18.1.7.5).

دویمي الکولونه د همغو عاملونو په واسطه کیټونونو ته اکسیډایز کېږي چې لومړني الکولونه اکسیډایز کوي.

19.4.4 د اروماتیکونو فریډل-کرافټس اسایلېشن

بنزین د لیوس اسید کتلست په شتون کې له اسید هالایډونو (یا انهایدرایډونو) سره تعامل کوي او اروماتیک کیټونونه ورکوي. د بېلګې په توګه بنزین د المونیم کلوراید کتلست په شتون کې له اسیټیل کلوراید سره تعامل کوي او اسیټوفینون جوړوي (برخه 16.8.5.2.6).

19.4.1 Ozonolysis of Alkenes

Ozone reacts vigorously with alkenes to form an unstable intermediate compound called ozonide. The ozonide is reduced directly to aldehydes and ketones by zinc and water, to produce aldehyde and/or ketones. The reaction is called ozonolysis. Symmetrical alkene produces single product while asymmetric alkene yield a mixture of aldehydes/ketones (Section 16.5.7.7). For example, ozonolysis of symmetric but-2-ene (both cis and trans) gives only acetaldehyde, while asymmetric 2-methylbut-2-ene yields a mixture of acetaldehyde and acetone.

19.4.2 Hydration of Alkynes

Alkynes undergo acid-catalyzed addition of water across the triple bond in the presence of mercuric sulphate and sulfuric acid as a catalyst to produce carbonyl compounds. Acetaldehyde is produced in case of acetylene, while ketones are produced from higher alkynes (Section 16.7.8.4).

19.4.3 Oxidation of Alcohols

Oxidation of a primary alcohol with strong oxidizing agents like, acidified chromate (CrO₄²⁻), dichromate (Cr₂O₇²⁻) or permanganate (MnO₄⁻) solution leads to the formation of a carboxylic acid as final product, through aldehydes intermediate. However, good yield of aldehydes can be obtained using oxidizing agents such as pyridinium chlorochromate (PCC), a complex of chromium trioxide with pyridine and HCl, without over (excessive) oxidation (Section 18.1.7.5).

Secondary alcohols are oxidized to ketones by the same reagents that oxidize primary alcohols.

19.4.4 Friedel-Crafts Acylation of Aromatics

Benzene reacts with acid halides (or anhydrides) in the presence of a Lewis acid catalyst to give aromatic ketones. For example, benzene react with acetyl chloride in the presence of aluminum chloride catalyst to form acetophenone (Section 16.8.5.2.6).
